misconceptions.description: Believing chatbot conversations are private by default.
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes personal or confidential details
misconceptions.feedback: Prompts go to the provider and may be stored, used for training or shared. Leave out what is not needed.

misconceptions.description: Believing deleting a chat removes it everywhere.
misconceptions.trigger: learner shares sensitive data planning to delete it later
misconceptions.feedback: Deletion may not reach every copy. The safest protection is not to include sensitive data in the first place.
